ceu: ✦ The conjunction between the Sun and Venus

t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. This is where your strength lies today.
With Venus retrograde in your intimacy sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on relationships and partnerships. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.

The Sun and Venus are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on routine, daily work and health. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
With Venus retrograde in your daily routine sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on home and family. It is a good day to start something in this area.
With Venus retrograde in your home and family sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on your money and what you value. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
With Venus retrograde in your money sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Share a meal with someone important to you.

t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.

The Sun and Venus are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on your image and your personal energy. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Make a short list of three tasks and get them done.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on rest and your inner life. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
With Venus retrograde in your inner life sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Go for a walk with no destination and no hurry.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on friends and plans for the future. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Look at an old photograph and remember where your strength comes from.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on your career and your goals. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
With Venus retrograde in your career sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Reply to that message you keep leaving for later.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Value your time: do not work for free for people who can pay.
